correctness.rationale: The upper-bound polynomial forces boundary support and the exact Poisson moments; rational Herglotz transform gives the full Blaschke n+1-atom family, diagonal orthogonality gives exact weights, monotone phase plus strict angular distance gives unique minimax/maximin phases and root equations. Endpoint Taylor analysis proves the fixed-a limits. The finite checker supports but does not replace the infinite proof.
